mechanism: Foscarnet causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia), while meloxicam reduces renal perfusion through NSAID-mediated prostaglandin inhibition, significantly increasing risk of acute kidney injury and drug accumulation.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, monitor renal function closely (SCr, BUN, electrolytes) every 2-3 days, ensure adequate hydration, and consider alternative analgesia or reduce meloxicam dose with renal function adjustment.
